caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The candlestick is rendered in shades of brown, with white highlights and decorative accents. It has a broad, circular base that narrows as it rises and then flares outward again near the top. The upper portion is detailed with a ruffled, crown-like rim and rounded elements just below it. On the broad, tapered midsection of the candlestick, a white illustration depicts a bird with a long neck and beak, standing among grass and tall plants. The style of the drawing emphasizes the smooth, glossy surface of the candlestick and the contrast between the brown and white colors in the decorative motif. There are no other objects or patterns visible in the composition.
title: Scent Bottle with Stopper
